# OpenALG - Adaptive Learning Guide

> > OpenALG (Open Adaptive Learning Guide) provides interactive study guides and learning modules for computer networking and IT education, developed by KSU.

This platform offers comprehensive educational resources focused on data communication and networking topics, including detailed coverage of transport layer protocols (TCP, UDP) and routing protocols (RIP, OSPF, BGP). The adaptive learning approach helps students master complex networking concepts through structured study guides.

## Key Topics

- TCP (Transmission Control Protocol)
- UDP (User Datagram Protocol)
- RIP (Routing Information Protocol)
- OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)
- BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)
- Transport Layer Protocols
- Routing Protocols
- Data Link Layer
- Networking Course Materials
- Study Guides
- Learning Modules
- OpenALG Platform
- KSU Educational Resources

## Networking Study Guides

- [Data Communication and Networking in IT - Study Guide](https://alg.manifoldapp.org/read/data-communication-and-networking-in-it/section/970072a0-7d61-4d4e-b1a8-49f77703f6a3): Comprehensive networking study guide covering TCP, UDP, RIP, OSPF, and BGP protocols with focus on transport layer and routing protocols
